Title: Butter Chicken
Ingredients: chicken breast, yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cumin, butter, onion, garlic, ginger, tomato puree, heavy cream, kasuri methi
Instructions:
1. Marinate the chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
2. Cook the chicken in a pan until browned, then remove.
3. Make the curry strictly using tomatoes, butter, and cream, then simmer the chicken inside. Serve hot!

Title: Paneer Tikka Masala
Ingredients: paneer, yogurt, gram flour, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, onion, bell pepper, tomato puree, cream, ginger, garlic
Instructions:
1. Marinate paneer cubes and bell peppers in spiced yogurt.
2. Grill or pan-fry the paneer cubes until golden.
3. Prepare a rich tomato-onion gravy, add the paneer, and simmer with cream. Serve hot!

Title: Chicken Biryani
Ingredients: basmati rice, chicken, yogurt, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, green chilies, mint leaves, coriander leaves, biryani masala, saffron, ghee
Instructions:
1. Parboil the basmati rice with whole spices.
2. Marinate chicken and cook it with onions, tomatoes, and biryani masala.
3. Layer the cooked chicken and rice, garnish with saffron and mint, and slow-cook (dum) for 20 minutes.

Title: Dal Makhani
Ingredients: whole black lentils, kidney beans, butter, cream, tomato puree, ginger, garlic, cumin, garam masala, chili powder
Instructions:
1. Soak lentils and beans overnight, then pressure cook until soft.
2. In a pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and tomato puree until oil separates.
3. Mix the lentils in, add butter and cream, and slow-cook for 30 minutes until creamy.

Title: Palak Paneer
Ingredients: paneer, spinach, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, green chilies, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cream
Instructions:
1. Blanch spinach leaves and blend them into a smooth puree.
2. Sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes, then add the spices.
3. Mix in the spinach puree and paneer cubes, simmering gently before finishing with a splash of cream.

Title: Chole Bhature
Ingredients: chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, chole masala, tea leaves, all-purpose flour, yogurt, baking powder, oil
Instructions:
1. Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas with a tea bag for color.
2. Cook a spicy onion-tomato gravy with chole masala, then fold in the chickpeas.
3. Knead a dough from flour and yogurt, roll into discs, and deep-fry into fluffy Bhature to serve.

Title: Aloo Gobi
Ingredients: potatoes, cauliflower, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala
Instructions:
1. Cut potatoes and cauliflower into florets and chunks.
2. Sauté cumin, onions, tomatoes, and ginger-garlic paste until softened.
3. Toss in the vegetables, cover, and steam until tender. Garnish with cilantro.

Title: Masala Dosa
Ingredients: rice, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, potatoes, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, green chilies
Instructions:
1. Soak rice and lentils overnight, then blend and ferment the batter.
2. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds and tossing cooked potatoes with turmeric.
3. Spread the batter thinly on a hot griddle, crisp up with oil, and fold the potato masala inside.

Title: Rogan Josh
Ingredients: lamb, mutton, yogurt, onion, garlic, ginger, fennel powder, ginger powder, kashmiri chili powder, whole spices, mustard oil
Instructions:
1. Sear the meat in hot mustard oil with whole spices.
2. Add browned onions and the spiced yogurt mixture.
3. Slow-cook the lamb on low heat until the meat is incredibly tender and the vibrant red oil separates.

Title: Samosa
Ingredients: all-purpose flour, ajwain, ghee, potatoes, green peas, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, garam masala, amchur powder
Instructions:
1. Knead a stiff dough using flour, ajwain, and ghee.
2. Prepare the filling by mashing boiled potatoes and tossing them with peas and toasted spices.
3. Roll out the dough, shape into cones, stuff with the filling, and deep-fry until golden.

Title: Gulab Jamun
Ingredients: milk powder, all-purpose flour, ghee, milk, sugar, water, cardamom, rose water, saffron
Instructions:
1. Make a soft dough using milk powder, a little flour, and milk.
2. Roll into smooth balls and fry on low heat until dark golden-brown.
3. Instantly soak the fried dough balls in warm cardamom and saffron-infused sugar syrup for hours.

Title: Malai Kofta
Ingredients: paneer, potatoes, cornstarch, cashew nuts, raisins, onion, tomato, cream, garam masala, ginger, garlic
Instructions:
1. Mash paneer and potatoes, stuff with nuts, and fry into golden dumpling koftas.
2. Make a luxurious, sweet-and-savory cashew-tomato-onion gravy.
3. Submerge the fried koftas into the creamy gravy right before serving.

Title: Pav Bhaji
Ingredients: potatoes, peas, cauliflower, bell pepper, onion, tomato, pav bhaji masala, butter, pav bread, lemon
Instructions:
1. Boil and aggressively mash all the vegetables together.
2. Sauté onions and tomatoes in ample butter, then mix with the mashed veg and pav bhaji masala.
3. Serve the piping-hot bhaji with toasted, butter-soaked pav buns and raw onions.

Title: Chicken Tikka
Ingredients: boneless chicken, yogurt, ginger garlic paste, kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice, mustard oil
Instructions:
1. Marinate chicken chunks in spiced yogurt and mustard oil for at least 2 hours.
2. Thread the chicken onto skewers.
3. Grill, bake, or tandoor the chicken until cooked through with charred edges. Serve with mint chutney.

Title: Matar Paneer
Ingredients: paneer, green peas, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, cashew nuts, turmeric, garam masala, coriander powder
Instructions:
1. Blend sautéed onions, tomatoes, and cashews into a curry paste.
2. Cook the paste with dry spices until the oil leaves the sides of the pan.
3. Fold in the green peas and paneer cubes, simmering until soft and infused.
